doc.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996

title: Marshall Royal and band nicknames
summary: Marshall Royal as gruff genius lead alto, called Field Marshall and Burgermeister; band nicknames.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: That’s right. And turn it totally into something else. Marshall Royal was pretty good at that too you know. Marshall was very bright and he was a very fine lead alto player, very gruff but he was a genius. Very gruff. A beautiful sound, and it was just one of the most natural musicians I ever encountered.
They call it “Straw Boss.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
Yeah, well we called him the “Field Marshall” and the “Burgermeister.” That was his whole attitude and everything. But he could back it up. Yeah. He was great.
Everybody seemed to get nicknames along the way.
Oh, yeah. We still do that.
I’m not going to tell you.
